title: Add Sparkline Chart Mark

complexity.rationale: No open design questions — layout and path drawing directly reuse Line's existing spec builder (continuous dimension/metric scales, path mark, hover-animation enter transition). The only non-precedented piece is a static last-point marker, which follows the same symbol-mark pattern already used by LinePointAnnotation.

summary: A minimal single-series line mark with no axes, legend, or interactivity — for compact inline trend indicators. Reuses Line's path construction and enter animation, adding only a static highlighted marker on the last data point.
requirements: Accepts only x and y (metric/dimension) channels — no color or series facet; a Sparkline renders exactly one series
Renders with no Axis, no Legend, and no keyboard/roving-tabindex navigation, regardless of what's nested under <Chart>
No hover tooltip or ChartPopover support — Sparkline is non-interactive by design
Reuses Line's path-draw enter animation (stroke-dash sweep) rather than introducing a new animation
Renders a static, always-visible marker highlighting the last point in the series
Fully responsive to its container's width/height, no fixed pixel dimensions

edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Render nothing; do not throw. No axes exist to host an empty-state message.
Render only the last-point marker; no path segment (matches a zero-length line).
Ignored — Sparkline has no color/series channel, so any such field has no effect on rendering.
Scales recompute against container size via the existing responsive sizing hook; no minimum-width fallback.
Stroke and last-point marker colors resolve through the existing colorScheme-aware static color value, matching Line's background-aware defaults.
S1-only for this spec; no S2 port until the mark stabilizes out of rc status.
SVG root still receives a localized aria-label even though there is no keyboard-focusable content, since the mark is non-interactive by design.

crossCutting.notes: touchesHoverAnimation: reuses Line's isAnimate-gated path-draw enter transition from lineMarkUtils.ts — must confirm it still fires correctly with the hover/tooltip signals Sparkline intentionally omits. requiresS1S2Parity: false because this ships as a new s1-only rc-status mark (packages/react-spectrum-charts-s2/src/rc/components/), matching how Donut/BigNumber were introduced before any S2 port; revisit once the mark is promoted out of rc.

implementationPlan.change: Create SparklineOptions/SparklineOptionsWithDefaults/SparklineSpecOptions, modeled on lineSpec.types.ts's LineOptions but omitting color/series, axis, legend, and tooltip/popover child fields entirely.
Add SparklineOptions to the MarkOptions union.
Fully-populated defaultSparklineOptions fixture, modeled on lineTestUtils.ts's defaultLineOptions.

getSparklineMark, reusing the path-mark construction and enter-animation encode from lineMarkUtils.ts's getLineMark; add getLastPointMark for the static highlighted end marker (symbol mark, similar shape to a LinePointAnnotation point).

addSparkline, addData, addSignals (no-op — no interactive signals), setScales (reuse addContinuousDimensionScale/addMetricScale), modeled on lineSpecBuilder.ts's addLine with axis/legend/tooltip options removed.
Unit tests for getSparklineMark and getLastPointMark using the new fixture.
Per-function tests for addData/addSignals/setScales using initializeSpec() and the fixture.
Register sparklineCount: -1 in initializeComponentCounts, import addSparkline, add the 'sparkline' switch case.
SparklineProps/SparklineElement, Omit-ing only fields replaced at the React boundary.
Render-null component holding prop defaults, placed under rc/ per the Donut/BigNumber rc-status precedent.
Import Sparkline from '../rc' and add its displayName dispatch case, following the Donut case.
Add Sparkline to the sanitizeRscChartChildren import/list from '../rc'.
Update the toStrictEqual ChartOptions snapshot to include the new mark type at default values.
Basic story showing a Sparkline with no Axis/Legend siblings.

openQuestions: Should Sparkline accept a color/style override prop for the last-point marker, or always derive it from the same static color as the line stroke?

Does 'highlights last point' mean the marker is always visible, or only appears on chart mount as part of the enter animation and then persists — needs a design decision if product wants a fade-in-then-static behavior distinct from Line's own point rendering.
